name: Fameglow Holdings Limited
summary: Fameglow Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides medical aesthetic services in Hong Kong. It offers non-surgical medical aesthetic services; energy-based procedures, such as energy-based devices that emit different types of energy on the skin surface; minimally invasive procedures, including injection treatments; and traditional beauty services comprising non-medical and non-invasive treatments. The company also provides skincare products. In addition, it operates medical aesthetic centers under the per Face brand. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Lai Chi Kok, Hong Kong.
